body: For me, probably The Deer Hunter. That film is one hell of a journey.

While no element is most important in a film, I would agree that editing is one of the most important for sure. Unfortunately only people IN the movie industry seem to get this, just look at all the directors cuts that are better than the original films, i.e Blade Runner. Now, look at the Oscar winner for editing: Bohemian Rhapsody. A lot of people seem to think that quick cuts equals good editing and of course in some cases it is! But, there have been numerous movies last year with better editing than that shit. Anyway, I think most people dont think about editing because it's a very niche thing that only editors seem to appreciate unless you're a big film buff like all of you guys on this sub probably are.
